description: Test conservation enrichment statistically and plot the nucleotide-pocket occlusion comparison
code:
exec(open("lib.py").read())
import json, numpy as np
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
cons=np.load("adck1_ortholog_conservation.npy")
rows=json.load(open("adck1_motif_conservation.json"))
core=cons[99:400]
bg=(core>=95).mean()
motif=np.array([r[3] for r in rows]); k=int((motif>=95).sum()); n=len(motif)
p_bin=stats.binomtest(k,n,bg,alternative='greater').pvalue
print("Catalytic/nucleotide-site positions >=95%% conserved: %d/%d (%.0f%%)"%(k,n,100*k/n))
print("Background (kinase core 100-400): %.1f%% of positions >=95%% conserved"%(100*bg))
print("Exact binomial test, one-sided: p = %.3g ; enrichment ratio = %.2f"%(p_bin,(k/n)/bg))
# Mann-Whitney on conservation values
mp=[r[1] for r in rows]
other=np.array([cons[j] for j in range(99,400) if (j+1) not in mp])
u=stats.mannwhitneyu(motif,other,alternative='greater')
print("Mann-Whitney U (motif vs other core positions): U=%.0f p=%.3g ; medians %.1f%% vs %.1f%%"%(u.statistic,u.pvalue,np.median(motif),np.median(other)))

# ---- pocket figure ----
rep=json.load(open("anp_pocket_report.json"))
names=[r['name'] for r in rep]; cl=[r['clash_2p2'] for r in rep]; tm=[r['tm'] for r in rep]
order=np.argsort(cl)
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.6))
cols=['#E45756' if 'ADCK1 (AF)' in names[i] else ('#54A24B' if 'apo' not in names[i] else '#9D9D9D') for i in order]
ax[0].barh([names[i] for i in order],[cl[i] for i in order],color=cols)
ax[0].set_xlabel("AMP-PNP heavy-atom clashes < 2.2 Å after superposition onto COQ8A 5I35")
ax[0].set_title("An ATP-sized pocket is open in the ADCK1 model")
ax[0].invert_yaxis()
for i,ii in enumerate(order): ax[0].text(cl[ii]+0.4,i,str(cl[ii]),va='center',fontsize=8)
ax[1].scatter(tm,cl,c=cols,s=55)
for i,n_ in enumerate(names): ax[1].annotate(n_,(tm[i],cl[i]),fontsize=7,xytext=(3,4),textcoords='offset points')
ax[1].set_xlabel("TM-score vs COQ8A 5I35"); ax[1].set_ylabel("AMP-PNP clashes < 2.2 Å")
ax[1].set_title("Fold similarity vs pocket occlusion")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
